description: This file is a PHP script for a module in the vtiger CRM system. It initializes a Smarty template engine, sets up some variables related to the current theme and language, and displays the 'SysInformation.tpl' template. It appears to be responsible for rendering system or configuration information.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A class wrapping the Smarty template engine for vtiger CRM.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the specified Smarty template ('SysInformation.tpl') to the browser.
